entries.source: Sanitized OpenAI SDK 6.40.0 Realtime WebSocket event shapes replayed through the mounted gateway against a strict local WebSocket
notes: Pooler validates documented client and server JSON event types and lifecycle while preserving accepted text frames byte-for-byte; it does not translate the Realtime protocol.
Caller openai-insecure-api-key subprotocols are stripped and never forwarded; the selected upstream credential is injected at the provider boundary.
Application messages must be complete text frames. Audio is the documented base64 JSON field; binary application frames and fragmented JSON are rejected.
The one-hour route timeout is an absolute connection-age ceiling. Pooler does not reconnect or replay a committed WebSocket session.
This is strict-loopback evidence, not live OpenAI provider conformance.
Replay: cargo test -p pooler-server --test gateway_preset the_gateway_preset_validates_openai_realtime_lifecycle --locked.

entries.source: OpenAI SDK 6.40.0 executable resource methods for GA client secrets, deprecated beta sessions/transcription sessions, and SIP call controls, plus mounted sideband query preservation
notes: The installed SDK exports POST /realtime/client_secrets and deprecated beta POST /realtime/sessions and /realtime/transcription_sessions methods.
The installed SDK exports only POST accept, reject, refer, and hangup methods under /realtime/calls/{call_id}; the gateway mounts those four exact action templates only for OpenAI.
The SDK contains translation session types but no exported resource method or HTTP path for creating one, so Pooler does not invent or mount a translation-session endpoint.
Sideband uses the existing /v1/realtime WebSocket route and preserves call_id; it is not a separate endpoint family.
Returned ephemeral secrets and identifiers in the fixture are synthetic; this is strict-loopback evidence, not live OpenAI conformance.
Replay: cargo test -p pooler-server --test gateway_provider_auth openai_realtime_control_routes_match_the_sdk_wire_contract --locked.
Replay: cargo test -p pooler-server --test gateway_preset openai_realtime_sideband_reuses_the_call_id_websocket_route --locked.
